metadata.case_name: LEUNG YIU SHEUNG v. PA LING LOGISTICS CO LTD

plaintiff.occupation_after: casual delivery worker; later lorry driver cum delivery worker

injuries.description: fracture of the distal shaft of left tibia and fibula
source: Doctors at the orthopaedics department of KWH found that the plaintiff had suffered from fracture of the distal shaft of left tibia and fibula with two 1 cm wounds over the fracture.
the diagnosis of fracture left tibia and fibula was compatible and consistent with the mechanism of injury that the left leg fracture was solely attributable to the Accident.
Fracture left tibia and fibula healed with mild deformity;

injuries.description: contusion injury of both shoulders with soft tissue involvement
source: the plaintiff suffered from left leg fracture and soft tissue injury to both shoulders in the Accident.
He sustained contusion injury of both shoulders with soft tissue involvement in the Accident;
physical examination revealed there was tenderness over the posterior aspects of both shoulders
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of shoulder or upper arm

manifestations.description: unable to walk for a long period of time; difficulty in squatting; could only walk on stairs slowly; pain extends to the left knee
left leg weakness, difficulty in carrying heavy items
occasional left leg cramps during sleep
affecting the plaintiff's temper and social life in a negative way
multiple surgical scars at the left leg including 6 scars at the shin and anterior knee, including a 3 cm scar at anterior knee and a 7 cm scar at distal shin
tenderness over the posterior aspects of both shoulders
deformity and 2 lacerations with mild oozing over his left ankle
mild left knee stiffness over flexion and mild left ankle stiffness over dorsiflexion and plantarflexion
bony deformity and prominence anterior distal left leg
reduced endurance on prolonged walking, standing, squatting and heavy manual work; limitation on heavy lifting and carrying

treatments_received.treatment: Intramedullary nailing of the left tibia
source: Intramedullary nailing of the left tibia was performed on 21 August 2014.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Closed reduction for fracture of arm / leg / patella / pelvis with internal fixation

source: he was subsequently admitted for wound drainage and debridement
The plaintiff was re-admitted to KWH again for the removal of the intramedullary nail on 5 December 2014.

treatments_received.treatment: Course of antibiotics (6-week course at WTSH)
source: The plaintiff also stayed at the WTSH for a 6-week course of antibiotics.

treatments_received.treatment: Physiotherapy (7 occasions from 18 September 2014 to 31 March 2015)
source: The plaintiff attended physiotherapy treatment on a total of 7 occasions spanning from 18 September 2014 to 31 March 2015.

losses.description: Unable to walk for a long period of time; difficulty in squatting; could only walk on stairs slowly; reduced endurance on prolonged walking, standing and squatting.
Multiple surgical scars at the left leg including 6 scars at the shin and anterior knee, including a 3 cm scar at anterior knee and a 7 cm scar at distal shin.
Such disabilities have affected the plaintiff's temper and social life in a negative way.

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Shing Ching v Hong Kong District Security Ltd and Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: plaintiff suffered fracture at his right tibia and fibular; wound debridement and application of external skeletal fixator was done, followed by removal of external fixator and intramedullary nailing; admitted again for treatment of skin graft wound infection; confined to a wheelchair for 4 months; thereafter walked with walking frame or sticks.

comparable_cases.case_name: Ko Chu Keung v Temmuk Engineering Co Ltd And Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: fracture of the right tibia and fibula with a 10 cm x 4 cm contaminated open wound over the right leg with exposed bone; wound irrigation, antibiotics and skin traction; intramedullary nailing of the right tibia and plating of the right fibula; second debridement; implant and stitches removed.

comparable_cases.case_name: Sukhdeep Singh v Chow Kin Hung And Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: fractured distal tibia and fibula of right leg; open reduction and internal fixation of the fibula and nailing of the tibia; bone graft taken from right knee; re-admitted for removal of surgical implant due to continued pain and discomfort.
